responsibility: Applies IRA’s regional-allocation decisions back to RTL by introducing split pseudos and move code at region boundaries. When nested regions assign different hard registers to allocnos for the same original pseudo, this file traverses the loop-tree top-down, creates replacement allocnos/pseudos, generates edge and block-border shuffles (including swap-breaking temporaries), updates live ranges/copies/costs for the new moves, and repairs insn recognition state after CFG edits. It is IRA’s code-rewriting and IR-flattening stage after coloring.
